author: Mehrp
body:
Ok, so I got warned for this:
HyperActive132? » HO HO HO
Awesomerp? » onononono
HyperActive132? » SWITCH
Awesomerp? » yupyupyup
Awesomerp? » computercomputercomputercomputer
HyperActive132? » HO HOHO
Awesomerp? » :D
Edit: just to be clear, I picked out lines which are made by me and hyper, there was other speaking in this, the chat wasn't a block of me and hyper speaking


We were making a reference to a quite comical clip we watched which can be found here:
http://thebest404pageever.com/swf/com-pyuu-tah.swf

He did mention that he verballed, but that was over 3 minutes before we started to do this. we have done this before and have gotten no warn, I therefore assumed that I could reference a funny clip again. The combined 7 sentances (with the longest being evident, computerx4) meant that I have gotten a warn, one which I disagree with. I do apologise very much if I disrupted anything with these 7 lines, but I am far more angered than apologetic in this. I was very shocked when zacd told me that mods do not have to verbal and can go straight to warn. This personally seems very infraction thirsty and a few (unnamed) players agree with me here. The verbal (the one sent 3 mins ago which would have been not addressed to us as seen here: http://gyazo.com/ac2227d68d2a7eb5ab5e6dbe3e7c4180 -we were not 'spamming' there.) instead seems directed at the flood of 'gg' appearing. But of course, I am giving false appealment (if there is such thing) because verbal isn't an essential. Something appears quite wrong here, at least in my eyes and even if nothing is done to pave the way to a fairer system by, namely, adding a verbal as a 'must' before punishment; then at least appeal this infraction which is the only 'spam' infraction i have (mostly because when I do get carried away-and I must admit that I do, this however was not one of those moments- a kInd moderator would inform me that I was getting rather close to being punished; and, being respectful of that kind moderator, I would oblige.

Thanks for reading this (even If you aren't really doing this by choice), merp.
Last notes: 
-You will no doubt have logs, so go ahead and verify them to make sure my client logs match up)
-7 rather short lines and a punishment, without a verbal being directed at us (with the only one being 3 mins away directed at the people who were flooding chat) seems a bit... excessive? .-.

replies.body: Bumping as I have not yet received any result.

replies.author: Avidead
replies.body:
Hello, 

I have decided not to appeal your infraction, because your infraction is legitimate and will not be reconsidered. After checking the logs I noticed that you posted about 9 messages in the span of one minute. That in any book would be categorised as 'spamming.' There is no reason to appeal; however, do not take your warn as a detriment to your reputation.

Cheers, 
BiasedSeniorMod,
Avicus Network Senior Mod.
